regeneration_reason: Finalized after ISSUE-20260831-001 run-reference image layout change and successful Web CI run 33351599395. The map records the right-side view-location rail on wide screens, narrow-screen stacking and dedicated browser geometry regression coverage. API, DB and route boundaries are unchanged.

nodes.label: Web App Shell
nodes.role: Authentication, dashboard, projects and user-administration shell.

nodes.label: Project Workspace
nodes.role: Project tabs and composition of design, run, Excel/export and recycle-bin panels.

nodes.label: Test Design UI
nodes.role: Scenario editor and FolderExplorer orchestration, including rename, move, versioned delete and scenario-editor save.

nodes.label: Folder Explorer
nodes.role: Folder/scenario tree selection, context menus, rename, delete and drag/drop.

nodes.label: Run Workspace
nodes.role: Run creation/execution, conflict UI, test data, view-location images, evidence handling, retained procedures component and versioned destructive requests. Existing view-image edit/lightbox behavior is preserved while CSS controls the reference-image placement.

nodes.label: Web UI Foundations
nodes.role: Run-workspace and evidence layout foundations. Evidence upload groups file selection and clipboard input in one top area, places description below at matching width, removes duplicated helper headings, and keeps responsive stacking.
constraints: Evidence remains optional at workflow level.
Do not display redundant required/optional wording for the evidence section or description.
File input and clipboard action stay visually grouped; description follows below at full width.

nodes.label: Run View-Location Layout
nodes.role: When a focused run case has view-location images, CSS Grid places instructions/test data on the left and a 220-248px reference rail on the right on wide screens. Results/evidence remain full-width below; at 850px and below the reference stacks after test data.
constraints: Only applies when .focused-run-case has a direct .run-reference-images child.
Existing image lightbox and per-run edit behavior are unchanged.
The reference helper sentence is visually hidden to reduce redundant text.
No API, DB, route or snapshot semantics change.

nodes.label: Recycle Bin UI
nodes.role: Loads deleted versioned entities, retains each item version and issues versioned restore requests for cases, folders, scenarios, data sets, runs, evidence and procedures.
constraints: Restore requests include projectId and the client-observed entity version.

nodes.label: Browser API Client
nodes.role: Same-origin typed fetch wrapper for shell-level endpoints.

nodes.label: Fastify API Core
nodes.role: Authentication/admin routes, CSRF and request-scoped transaction hooks.

nodes.label: Feature Route Registration
nodes.role: Registers the destructive-concurrency preHandler before case, definition, scenario-editor, Excel, run, evidence, export and operations routes.

nodes.label: Destructive Concurrency Guard
nodes.role: For versioned delete/restore endpoints, requires authentication and project edit permission, then row-locks the target and compares client-observed version and deleted state before mutation.
constraints: Runs inside the request-scoped MariaDB transaction.
Uses a static entity/table whitelist.
SELECT ... FOR UPDATE lock is held through route mutation, audit and commit/rollback.
Stale version or stale active/deleted state returns HTTP 409.

nodes.label: Test Case Routes
nodes.role: Test-case CRUD, steps/tags/folders, duplication, delete and restore.
constraints: PATCH is optimistic-locked by test_cases.version.
DELETE/restore require the client-observed version and are guarded by destructiveConcurrency before mutation.

nodes.label: Definition Routes
nodes.role: Folder, scenario and data-set CRUD, relationships, delete and restore.
constraints: PATCH operations are optimistic-locked by entity version.
Folder/scenario/data-set DELETE and restore require the observed version and row-lock before mutation.

nodes.label: Scenario Editor Routes
nodes.role: Atomic scenario/case/common-data editor save and test-case view-image domain.
constraints: Existing scenario, case and common-data writes compare supplied versions and return 409 on stale state.
Composite save is transactional.

nodes.label: Run Domain Routes
nodes.role: Run snapshots, revisions, results, assignments, completion, delete and restore.
constraints: Run/run-case/run-scenario PATCH operations use optimistic locking.
Run DELETE and restore require observed version and destructiveConcurrency row lock.

nodes.label: Evidence and Procedure Routes
nodes.role: Evidence upload/download/versioning/delete/restore and retained procedure CRUD.
constraints: Evidence image version creation guards current_version.
Evidence/procedure DELETE and restore require the entity version and destructiveConcurrency row lock.

nodes.label: Excel Import Routes
nodes.role: Official template, preview and one-time confirm/import.
constraints: Import confirm atomically claims confirmed_at IS NULL to prevent double confirmation.

nodes.label: Canonical Web API Contract
nodes.role: Canonical HTTP contract. Version 1.0.1 documents projectId + version for versioned destructive mutations and 409 optimistic-lock conflicts.

nodes.label: MariaDB Persistence
nodes.role: MariaDB pool and AsyncLocalStorage request transaction boundary.
constraints: Each concurrent HTTP write uses its request-local transaction connection.
Destructive concurrency row locks are held on that request-local connection through commit/rollback.
Concurrent stale writes are expected to resolve as one success and one 409 when targeting the same versioned row.

nodes.label: User Session Store
nodes.role: Cookie token hashing, user_sessions lookup/creation and session invalidation semantics.
constraints: Each successful login creates a new independent user_sessions row.
Logout removes only the current session; password change removes other sessions; admin reset removes all target-user sessions.

flows.label: Concurrent browser sessions
constraints: Same-user sessions are independent; logging out one session does not invalidate another same-user session or a different user's session.
Multi-BrowserContext E2E verifies same-row 200/409 and independent-row 200/200 behavior.

flows.label: Run view-location reference layout
constraints: Wide screens keep operation/expected/test data on the left and view-location image in a 220-248px right rail.
Result controls and evidence remain full-width below the overview.
At 850px and below the image reference stacks after test data.
Image lightbox and per-run editor behavior remain unchanged.

flows.label: Evidence upload UI
constraints: Evidence creation is optional; the UI does not imply that evidence itself is mandatory.
File selection and clipboard paste are grouped at the top; description is below at the same full width.
Description does not display an unnecessary optional label.

flows.label: Delete and restore lifecycle
constraints: All mapped versioned DELETE/restore endpoints require the client-observed version.
Stale DELETE or stale restore returns 409 while the latest committed entity state is preserved.
